historicalInterpretation: After 5 seconds the profile central WebGL scene still differs: captured master displays box-like geometry while local displays the llama model. Local has public/assets/models/llama.glb (and award.glb); the captured upstream static checkout contains no GLB files. Local Experience code falls back to BoxGeometry when a model is unavailable. Treat this as a confirmed capture-vs-local visual difference, but do not infer canonical live-master behavior from the missing model in the captured snapshot.
latestConclusion: The local model is a high-confidence match to the captured original response: HAR status/size match exactly, and the extraction filename SHA-256 prefix matches the local full digest. The master GitHub tree omits the binary itself, and the raw HAR response body is absent, so full 256-bit identity remains unverified. The earlier master-box/local-llama comparison came from a fixture missing the master path. A later copied-file replay showed llama-shaped figures in both, but that replay is not identity evidence. Animation source comparison shows exact parity after normalizing only the local asset URL; unsynchronized Math.random seeds and shared-clock phase explain non-repeatable screenshot placements.
